SELECT
  COALESCE(r.rink_name, 'Unknown') AS rink_name,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE (g.home_team_id = 1 OR g.away_team_id = 1)
      AND g.game_status = 'completed'
  ) AS games,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN (g.home_team_id = 1 AND g.home_score > g.away_score)
        OR (g.away_team_id = 1 AND g.away_score > g.home_score)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) AS wins,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN (g.home_team_id = 1 AND g.home_score < g.away_score)
        OR (g.away_team_id = 1 AND g.away_score < g.home_score)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) AS losses,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN (g.home_team_id = 1 OR g.away_team_id = 1)
        AND g.home_score = g.away_score
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) AS ties
FROM public.game g
LEFT JOIN public.rink r ON r.rink_id = g.rink_id
WHERE (g.home_team_id = 1 OR g.away_team_id = 1)
  AND g.game_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY r.rink_name
ORDER BY r.rink_name;
